overview_description.description: Verbatica is an educational platform for learning foreign languages. The platform is designed to achieve a new level of performance in learning English and Arabic. Its learning method is based on thousands of hours of work by methodologists (practicing teachers who have mentored hundreds of students) and enhanced by customized artificial intelligence.
